subject: Discharge summary - Mrs Lakshmi Devi - UHID 0024518

discharged today. UHID 0024518.

Regards,
Dr S Menon
notes: The everyday case. UHID appears twice - subject and body.

subject: Discharge - bed 412

notes: MRN in colon form, no dashes - the shape the current recognizer misses.

subject: Biochemistry results - urgent review
body: Dr Nair,
Results for patient Sunita Bhatt (UHID 0031902):
Creatinine 2.4 mg/dL (was 1.6 last month)
eGFR 28
Potassium 5.9
Haemoglobin 8.2
Consistent with chronic kidney disease stage 3 (N18.3). Nephrology referral raised.
Please review today.
notes: Clinical values plus identifier. Lab values alone are covered by clinical-narrative-001.

subject: Bed 7 overnight
body: Overnight the patient in bed 7 became oliguric, creatinine climbed to 3.1 and
potassium to 6.2 with peaked T waves on the monitor. Started on calcium gluconate
and insulin-dextrose, dialysis line inserted at 0400. Family counselled about
the poor prognosis. Please review on the morning round.
notes: Pure clinical narrative, no crisp identifier. Document-level PHI only - this is the case span-level detection cannot reach and the risk model must.

notes: Multiple distinct patients in one message - a bulk exposure the risk model should weight above a single record.
